title.en: TikTok direct: photo carousel drafts, sent_to_inbox status, and cross-browser OAuth launch
title.zh: TikTok 官方直连升级：图文轮播草稿、sent_to_inbox 状态与跨浏览器 OAuth 启动

summary.en: TikTok direct now supports JPEG/WebP photo carousel drafts under video.upload, maps SEND_TO_USER_INBOX to non-terminal sent_to_inbox, routes OAuth through a single-use browser launch ticket with strict scope enforcement, and converges CLI social commands on tiktok_direct.
summary.zh: TikTok 官方直连新增 video.upload 图文轮播草稿上传，将 SEND_TO_USER_INBOX 映射为非终态 sent_to_inbox，OAuth 改经一次性同源启动中转入口并严格按实授 scope 判定权限，同时 CLI 社媒命令全面收敛至 tiktok_direct。

body.en:
TikTok direct publishing has been updated across OAuth connection reliability, photo draft uploads, inbox status semantics, and CLI commands.

### Photo carousel drafts (`video.upload`)

- `POST /api/social/v1/posts` in draft mode (`video.upload`) now supports both single-video drafts (`/v2/post/publish/inbox/video/init/`) and **photo carousel drafts** (`/v2/post/publish/content/init/` with `post_mode: "MEDIA_UPLOAD"`).
- Photo carousels accept **JPEG and WebP only** (no PNG/GIF and no mixed photo+video payloads). Image URLs are wrapped through the gateway's signed verified-domain media proxy. Hosted OmniMux supports **1 to 35 images** per photo post (matching the TikTok Photo API protocol maximum; self-hosted deployments default to 10 items and can be configured up to 35).
- Photo drafts accept optional `tiktok_options.title`, `tiktok_options.description` (falling back to `content`), `tiktok_options.photo_cover_index` (0-based integer, explicit `0` preserved), and `tiktok_options.is_aigc` (boolean, explicit `false` preserved), and never forward Direct Post-only privacy, interaction, or commercial disclosure fields.

### Non-terminal `sent_to_inbox` status

- `GET /api/social/v1/posts/{id}` with `refresh=1` now maps TikTok `SEND_TO_USER_INBOX` to `sent_to_inbox` instead of `processing`, while preserving the original upstream string in `result.status`.
- `sent_to_inbox` is **non-terminal**: subsequent `refresh=1` calls continue polling TikTok upstream and transition to `published` (`PUBLISH_COMPLETE`) or `failed` (`FAILED` / `FAIL`) after the creator completes or aborts posting in the TikTok app.

### Cross-browser OAuth launch and strict scope enforcement

- `POST /api/social/v1/connect` for `tiktok_direct` now returns a short-lived, single-use same-origin launch URL (`/api/social/v1/oauth/tiktok/start?ticket=...`, valid for 3 minutes). Opening it in the system browser sets the anti-CSRF cookie on the gateway origin and redirects (`302 Found`) to TikTok's official authorization page, preventing cross-browser callback failures from desktop and CLI clients.
- `capabilities.upload_draft` and `capabilities.publish_direct` on `GET /api/social/v1/accounts` are now computed strictly from the OAuth scopes actually returned by TikTok (fail-closed, with no fallback to app defaults). Accounts that declined `video.upload` report `upload_draft: false` and receive `409 SOCIAL_TIKTOK_SCOPE_MISSING` on `POST /api/social/v1/posts`.
- Token refresh rotation is now serialized per account to prevent concurrent refresh races.

### CLI convergence

- `omnimux social` commands converge on `--provider tiktok_direct`. Passing the retired `--provider zernio` fails locally with migration guidance before any network call.
- Added `omnimux social creator-info <account-id> --provider tiktok_direct` and extended `omnimux social post` with `--title`, `--description`, `--photo-cover-index`, `--is-aigc`, and `--tiktok-options`.
body.zh:
TikTok 官方直连发布在 OAuth 跨浏览器可靠性、图文轮播草稿上传、收件箱状态语义与 CLI 命令上完成升级。

### 图文轮播草稿上传（`video.upload`）

- 草稿模式（`video.upload`）下的 `POST /api/social/v1/posts` 现同时支持单条视频草稿（`/v2/post/publish/inbox/video/init/`）与**图文轮播草稿**（`/v2/post/publish/content/init/`，`post_mode: "MEDIA_UPLOAD"`）。
- 图文轮播仅支持 **JPEG / WebP**（拒绝 PNG/GIF，禁止图片与视频混排）；所有图片 URL 在提交至 TikTok 前经网关签名已验证域媒体代理包装；OmniMux 托管环境支持单帖 **1–35 张**图片（与 TikTok Photo API 协议上限一致；自部署环境默认单次最多 10 张，可按需配置最高至 35 张）。
- 图文草稿支持可选的 `tiktok_options.title`、`tiktok_options.description`（缺省回退 `content`）、`tiktok_options.photo_cover_index`（0 基整数，保留显式 `0`）与 `tiktok_options.is_aigc`（布尔值，保留显式 `false`），且不传递仅公开直发生效的隐私、互动与商业披露字段。

### 非终态 `sent_to_inbox` 状态语义

- `GET /api/social/v1/posts/{id}`（`refresh=1`）将 TikTok 上游 `SEND_TO_USER_INBOX` 映射为 `sent_to_inbox`（不再归入 `processing`），同时在 `result.status` 中保留上游原始状态值。
- `sent_to_inbox` 为**非终态**：后续 `refresh=1` 会持续轮询 TikTok 上游，并在创作者于 TikTok App 内完成发布后流转至 `published`（`PUBLISH_COMPLETE`）或 `failed`（`FAILED` / `FAIL`）。

### 跨浏览器 OAuth 启动与严格 scope 校验

- `POST /api/social/v1/connect`（`tiktok_direct`）现返回短效一次性同源启动中转入口（`/api/social/v1/oauth/tiktok/start?ticket=...`，有效期 3 分钟）。在系统浏览器打开该地址后由网关签发防 CSRF Cookie 再 `302 Found` 跳转至 TikTok 官方授权页，解决桌面端与 CLI 跨浏览器回调阻断问题。
- `GET /api/social/v1/accounts` 中的 `capabilities.upload_draft` 与 `capabilities.publish_direct` 严格按 TikTok 实际返回的授权 `scope` 计算（fail-closed，不回退应用默认配置）。未授予 `video.upload` 时 `upload_draft` 为 `false`，发帖返回 `409 SOCIAL_TIKTOK_SCOPE_MISSING`。
- Token 刷新轮换已按账号维度加锁防并发竞争。

### CLI 收敛

- `omnimux social` 命令统一收敛至 `--provider tiktok_direct`；传入已退役的 `--provider zernio` 会在发起网络请求前于本地报错并给出迁移提示。
- 新增 `omnimux social creator-info <account-id> --provider tiktok_direct`，并为 `omnimux social post` 补齐 `--title`、`--description`、`--photo-cover-index`、`--is-aigc` 与 `--tiktok-options` 参数。
